locomotion.generation: Use the three attached original game sprites as strict CHARACTER and FLAT ART STYLE references. Same chibi girl, huge cyan eyes with white rims, coral/red long hair and asymmetrical fringe, small tan ears, teal short dress with two white buttons and white waist stripe, white leggings/feet, no mouth, no outlines, no shading or added details. Preserve her recognizable proportions, colors and 3/4 view facing RIGHT. These are production animation frames for the SAME character, never a redesign. No text, labels, border lines, grid marks, scenery, shadows, props or duplicate characters within a cell. Real transparent RGBA background. Exactly equal grid cells, full character visible with generous transparent padding, constant scale and pivot. Crisp clean flat shapes, not pixel art. Frame order left to right, top to bottom. Generate a single 2048 by 1024 sprite sheet, EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, 32 distinct full-body poses. Row 1: 8 subtle in-between IDLE breathing/sway poses covering a complete seamless cycle, minimal displacement. Row 2: 8 evenly phased WALK in-between poses, alternating feet and opposite arm swing, complete cycle. Row 3: 8 evenly phased RUN in-between poses, energetic lean and alternating strides, complete cycle. Row 4: 8 ordered JUMP in-between poses from takeoff, rising with bent legs, apex, descending to extended legs before landing. Standing/locomotion sprites all the same height, feet at the same near-bottom baseline except articulated leg pose changes. Anchor the pelvis consistently. Every frame isolated inside its cell.
locomotion.cleanup: Clean up this existing sprite sheet for production use. Preserve EXACTLY the same 8 column x 4 row layout, the same 32 character poses, facial identity, red hair, cyan eyes, teal dress, white legs, dimensions, placement and scale. Remove ALL stray red, yellow, white or gray speckles, particle clouds, halos, shadows and residual background fragments OUTSIDE each solid character silhouette. Every pixel outside a character must be fully transparent with alpha zero. Antialiased edges are clean and crisp. Flat solid fills like the source game sprite, avoid gradient shading or texture. Do not redraw, redesign, duplicate or remove characters. Keep each complete character inside its grid cell; transparent gutters between cells and at outer borders. No text, lines, guides or scenery. Output a clean transparent RGBA PNG.
